reasoning.step1:
1) Document classification
- Look for invoice indicators: presence of "Rechnung", "Nr.", "Datum", totals ("Summe", "Gesamtbetrag") — present. No exclusion headers like "Mahnung" or "Zahlungserinnerung". Conclusion: document is an invoice.

2) Identify candidate fields and locate text
- Invoice.Date: lines show "Datum: 12.10.2023". Strong direct match.
- GrandTotal.Amount: line "Gesamtbetrag : EUR 235,98" — clear total payable.
- Sender.VatId: near company block: "ATU74758256" (preceded by "bbn 90 07167 6, ATU74758256") — looks like VAT ID.
- VAT groups: lines show "Summe excl. Mwst. 196,65" and "Summe Mwst. 39,33", and elsewhere Ust % column shows "20" for line items. Also "Summe Mwst. 39,33" and total 235,98 = 196,65 + 39,33, consistent with a single VAT rate of 20%.
- Vat.Rate: evident "20" in Ust % column and consistent with totals.
- Net.Amount: "Summe excl. Mwst. 196,65" corresponds to net total.
- Vat.Amount: "Summe Mwst. 39,33" corresponds to VAT amount.

3) Verify numeric formatting and rules
- Input uses comma as decimal separator (e.g., "235,98"). Per rules, keep number of decimal places the same as in input. Schema expects numbers (not strings) but also earlier rule "Keep the number of decimals places the same". Note later conversion to JSON numbers will require using numeric values; will preserve decimals.
- VAT rate must be returned without percentage symbol; source shows "20" (no percent sign in totals area but Ust % column uses "20").

4) Check for multiple occurrences / ambiguities
- Only one invoice-wide exchange rate not present—no ExchangeRate.Item relevant.
- VAT appears as a single group (20%) with corresponding net and VAT amounts. No other VAT groups present.
- Sender VAT ID appears only once; no conflicting VAT IDs.
- No need to infer any missing fields; all required fields have explicit values in text.

5) Possible uncertainties and rejection paths considered
- Alternative: treat "ATU74758256" as something else — but prefix ATU is Austrian VAT identifier format, matching Sender.VatId expected.
- Alternative: multiple VAT rates in line items (column shows "20" for each line) — but all lines show 20, and summary totals match single 20% grouping.
- No exclusion terms dominating header, so do not classify as non-invoice.

6) Final mapping (values to extract)
- Invoice.Date -> "12.10.2023"
- GrandTotal.Amount -> "235,98"
- Sender.VatId -> "ATU74758256"
- Vat.Rate -> 20
- Net.Amount -> "196,65"
- Vat.Amount -> "39,33"

All values are directly present in the text; no inference required.
